title: Complete lower-screen Blacksmith and Mage Guild
summary: Add the sixth Town service, Blacksmith, with a live native offer, price/gold, Buy and Close. Add visible Mage Guild spell lists, level filters, complete paged descriptions, optional native spell research and Close. Preserve native confirmations, server rules, window ownership and upper-screen input.
preparation: Verify the exact candidate receipt, package is.xyz.vcmi.thor and APK SHA-256; install preserving data. Prepare disposable saves with a built Blacksmith, a visiting owned hero, sufficient/insufficient gold and compatible/existing war machines. Include Guilds of several levels, a hero without a spellbook, an optional spell-research-enabled game and a Tower with Aurora Borealis if available. Record unavailable scenarios explicitly.
limitations: Replacement, spellbook-purchase and research confirmation/error dialogs keep their existing upper-screen controls. Lower Research opens the original scroll interaction; native research settings, cost and limits remain authoritative. No new gameplay, server, packet/save or primary-input behavior. Unsupported/oversized visible lists fail closed. Special Aurora Borealis scrolls show their native summary rather than an inferred list.

checks.title: Town service entry and live Blacksmith offer
checks.steps: Open Town Services with and without an available Blacksmith. With a visiting owned hero, open Blacksmith and compare machine, hero, price and gold with the upper dialog. Try missing visitor, insufficient gold and unavailable/incompatible machine cases. Close and reopen; switch Towns.
checks.expected: Six disjoint service controls retain the existing five services. Blacksmith entry follows native building availability. Missing visitor uses the existing native notice. The exact live offer is shown; unavailable purchases cannot be submitted. Close restores the correct Town.

checks.title: Purchase, replacement and rejection
checks.steps: Buy once with sufficient gold, then inspect the hero and resources. Where supported, buy a replacement and cancel, then confirm, using the original upper confirmation. Rapidly repeat Buy and change gold/visitor/ownership or close the upper dialog during a held lower tap.
checks.expected: At most one current offer executes through the original native callback. Replacement/cancel and server rejection retain ordinary behavior; rejected or canceled actions do not spend gold or show false success. Old releases cannot purchase another offer or target another hero; no stuck pending state.

checks.title: Every visible Guild level and complete details
checks.steps: Enter the Mage Guild from Town Services, including the native spellbook-purchase prompt for a hero without a book. Browse All levels and levels 1 through 5, use multiple list pages, select spells and page through long/localized descriptions, then return to the list. Compare every displayed spell/description with the upper Guild. Test empty levels and Aurora Borealis if available.
checks.expected: Only currently visible native scrolls are listed. Level filtering and list/detail paging reach the entire bounded publication; names/text fit and remain readable. Empty levels and special summary scrolls are explicit. Spellbook purchase keeps its native prompt and result. No hidden or unbuilt-level spell is exposed.

checks.title: Native spell research and modal restoration
checks.steps: With research enabled, select an eligible spell and tap Research. Inspect the upper native cost/replacement dialog; cancel and accept in separate trials. Exercise insufficient resources, daily limits and exhausted alternatives if practical. Repeat with research disabled. Close Guild and reopen.
checks.expected: Research is disabled when native settings/ownership/turn disallow it. Enabled Research invokes the original scroll interaction and original dialogs/rules. While a child is open, lower service actions withdraw; closing it restores the live Guild. Resulting spells/resources refresh and no old spell target or duplicate request executes.

checks.title: Stale input and display/activity lifecycle
checks.steps: Hold and drag a service control, add a second pointer, change the upper context, change Town/spells/resources, resize/recreate the presentation, toggle/reconnect the lower display and background/resume. Repeat while a lower action is pending or an upper confirmation is open.
checks.expected: Pointer/session/revision changes cancel old releases; local pending state recovers. Only one current deck returns with current data. No stale hit region, duplicate action, residual dialog, wrong-Town request or focus loss occurs.

checks.title: Existing decks and upper-input compatibility
checks.steps: Recheck Town overview/Army, Hall/build confirmation, recruitment, Tavern and Marketplace, Previous/Next/Close, Hero management, Hero Meeting, Adventure and Battle. Use upper touch/controller and repeat with the lower display disabled.
checks.expected: Existing actions, navigation, native window lifecycle and game rules are preserved. Upper input/focus and single-display fallback work normally; no crash, duplicate Presentation, old service content or update loop.
